podium.webp.prompt: A single game prop on a fully transparent background: a round stone display podium for a character-select screen, seen from about 18 degrees above, so its flat circular top reads as a wide ellipse about 3.3 times wider than tall. Low-poly faceted grey-blue granite with soft cel-shaded planes, a clean flat top face with a slightly lighter, smooth inner disc and a thin carved groove ring near its rim, the side band made of chunky cut stone blocks with a few tufts of green grass and two tiny white daisies at its base on one side. A subtle carved Poké Ball circle emblem centred on the front of the side band. Neutral cool grey colours so a coloured light can be tinted onto the top later; no glow, no coloured light, no character on it. Bright clean cartoon game art for a low-poly Pokémon-style adventure, matching a sunlit painted coastal meadow, soft daylight from upper left. No text, no letters, no frame, no cast shadow on the ground beyond a soft contact shade directly under it.

backdrop.webp.prompt: Paint a finished wide background for a Pokémon fan game's start lobby. The FIRST reference is a flat colour-blocking layout: follow its composition exactly (positions and sizes of the sky, sea, horizon, far shore, buildings, Lapras, path, meadow, cliffs, cloud, birds and tall grass). The SECOND reference is the painting style, light and palette: painterly anime, bright sunny day, saturated greens, soft blue sky. Content, block by block: the pale-green oval lower left is a flat calm meadow clearing with almost no detail. The dark-green shapes on the left and along the bottom are clumps of classic Pokémon tall grass with pointed blades; a small Oddish and a Caterpie peek out of the left tall grass where the yellow dots are. The tan strip is a dirt route path running up to the far shore. On the far shore, clearly readable even when small: a Pokémon Center (white walls, bright red roof, a Poké Ball emblem above the glass entrance) with a small Poké Mart (white walls, blue roof) beside it, a few small red and blue roofed houses to their right, and a white lighthouse with a red top. The dark shape on the sea just left of the path is a Lapras swimming toward the shore, clearly recognisable (long neck, shell). The brown marks in the sky are a flock of five Pidgey flying. Right side: green hills, rounded trees and a big soft cumulus cloud, gentle and low-contrast. Keep the upper-left sky plain apart from the Pidgey. No people, no text, letters, numbers or signage writing, no UI, frame, flat colour blocks or vignette.
backdrop.webp.rights: Generated for a noncommercial Pokémon fan project; character designs belong to their rights holders; no endorsed affiliation.

upscale.check: Compared at 2x DPR in the 1280x800 lobby comp and at 2x pixel crops against a Lanczos 2x of the source: sharper outlines, no added or changed detail on the Pokémon Center, Mart, houses, Lapras, Oddish or Caterpie.

Right cell: a red handheld Pokédex-style encyclopedia device, opened like a flip phone, a round blue lens light at the top corner, a small glowing screen and a few buttons, slightly three-quarter view. Bright clean cartoon game art for a low-poly Pokémon-style adventure. Chunky simple shapes, flat cel shading with two or three tones, soft rim light, thick rounded dark navy (#142f50) outline. Saturated but not neon colours, friendly and readable at 48 px. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no borders, no drop shadows outside the subject.
